paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.33% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+1.79%) and Nasdaq weakest (-1.25%). Brent crude changed -1.25% to 102.98. Gold changed +1.20% to 4,207.0. Bitcoin changed +0.89% to 82,400.4219. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.231%, a relative move of -0.87%. Among the firms tracked, BP (+4.16%) and Occidental (+3.56%) moved the most.
